k.q: Predict the CPU register printed from a zero-indexed array.
p: Explain what the PC and MAR actually store; name the search algorithm that works without sorting.
k.a: Index 2 prints PC; index 0 prints MAR. PC holds the next instruction address; MAR holds the address being accessed. Linear search can inspect an unsorted array. This array-access example is not itself a complete search.
